column1: # The second set of public-domain books the reading model learns from (scripts/train_reading_model.py --books2, default
# .cache/raw/reading-books-2): 98 works from zh.wikisource, all first published in 1930 or earlier (US public domain), read from
# the zh.wikisource dump of 2026-10-01 (zhwikisource-20261001-pages-articles-multistream.xml.bz2) by the offline corpus build of
# 2026-11-05, in the original script, one paragraph per line, a heading per page. None of them is in tests/corpus/zh or the
# sealed test set, nor a work of public/samples or scripts/data/reading-model-books.tsv (a few pieces overlap: 學而 in 論語, two
# essays of 民初散文選 in 郁達夫's and 李大釗's; places whose text is already there were not hand-labeled again). The Wu-dialect
# novels (海上花列傳, 九尾龜) and the three longest histories are left out. Hand labels in tests/corpus/zh/readings-calibration.tsv
# (folder wikisource-2) point into these texts by offset, so the training script warns about a text whose sha256 differs. The
# pages and their revisions are in reading-model-books-2-pages.tsv.gz.
# Columns: id, title, author, first published, genre, Han characters, sha256 of the .txt file.
